description:
Well we got there in the end, after testing the 6 main types of Cream available in Canada (Alberta to be specific) there is a clear winner!

What I don;t understand though, they use the excuse that transporting the cream and milk takes much longer over here (which is true). The distance to travel is indeed incredible BUT......let's not forget they use refrigerator trucks and tankars to move it all so that argument doesn't stand. 
How about just make milk and cream WITHOUT the 5 different types of stablizer and preservative. If people want them in, they can add it themselves. 

Thankfully for ice cream makers, we can benifit from one of the additives but the rest.......not thank you, it messes up your ice cream like you've never seen. 

If for some reason, I can get Lucerne cream, I will use dairyland 18% Coffee Cream. If I can't get that, i'll make my own cream at home!

------------------------

If you want to see me talk about ice cream stabilizers, check out this video:
https://youtu.be/GyTIS0ic3Qs
